E0907

`mul` doesn't match the `Mul` contract

What

`mul` doesn't match the `Mul` contract

Why

A trait implementation must use the trait method's receiver, parameters, return type, and effects.

Fix

Write `mul: fn(self, rhs: Money) -> Money`, matching the `Mul` declaration exactly, including `self`, types, labels, return type, and effects.
